title: Queue Runner Result v1
description: Result of a single FleetQueueRunner.run_once() call. Content-light: no raw file contents, diffs, patches, prompts, secrets, stdout, stderr, argv, or snippets.

queue_item_id.description: ID of the queue item that was processed, or null if idle.

runtime_result_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the runtime execution result metadata (content-light).

receipt_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the runtime tool invocation receipt.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was executed, if applicable.

error_kind.description: Structured error kind for failed/blocked decisions.

reason.description: Sanitised reason string. Content-light: truncated, no raw file data.

changed_paths.description: Paths that were changed by the execution, if available.
